name: 大逆转谜题
desc: 把自己的手卡和场上的卡全部送去墓地。对在自己卡组最上面的卡的种类（魔法·陷阱·怪兽）作猜测。猜对的场合，对方和自己的基本分交换。
faq: Sending all cards in the hand and on the field to the Graveyard is a cost. If there are no cards in your hand or on the field you cannot activate this card. You must have a card either in your hand or on the field to activate this card.
qas:
Q: If I activate “Reversal Quiz” with a “Black Pendant” on the field, does the damage from “Black Pendant” occur before or after our Life Points are exchanged?
A: After. Curtis Schultz, 04/04/2004
